_description: Produced by: Phase 12 explainability engine. Consumed by: Frontend explanation UI, audit trails, medical review.

sample_id._description: Identifier for the specific sample being explained (e.g., test set index or patient ID).

actual_label._description: True label if available (for error analysis).

feature_importance._description: Top contributing features ranked by importance/effect on prediction.
feature_importance._method_classical: SHAP values for tree-based models, coefficients for linear models

_example._description: Higher value pushes prediction toward positive class
Value pushes prediction toward negative class

global_importance._description: Average feature importance across entire test set (not sample-specific).

circuit_diagram_url._description: Path to generated circuit visualization image.

pipeline_trace._description: Complete pipeline lineage showing how this prediction was produced.

perturbation_analysis._description: Feature perturbation analysis showing sensitivity to input changes.

feature_0_perturbation.interpretation: Decreasing this feature significantly reduces disease probability

counterfactual._description: Minimal feature changes that would flip the prediction (if computed).

confidence_calibration._description: Calibration information if available (Phase 12 may compute this).
confidence_calibration._note: Uncalibrated scores should not be interpreted as true probabilities.

model_decision_reason._description: Human-readable explanation of why the model made this prediction.
model_decision_reason._example: The model predicted POSITIVE (malignant) with score 0.873. The prediction was strongly influenced by elevated mean_radius (17.23, importance 0.312) and worst_concave_points (0.145, importance 0.241), which are characteristic indicators in the training data. The actual label was POSITIVE, so this is a correct prediction.

warnings._description: Warnings about explanation reliability or limitations.
_example: This explanation is based on perturbation analysis and may not reflect true model causality.
Prediction score is uncalibrated and should not be interpreted as clinical probability.
This is a research system output, not a clinical diagnosis.
